menu.label: Grab Size
menu.supertip: Opens a chooser: grab the width, the height, or both. Each grab replaces the previous one. Select exactly one shape first.

button.label: Grab Both
button.screentip: Remember this shape's width and height

menu.label: Grab Position
menu.supertip: Opens a chooser: grab the left edge, the top edge, both, or size and position together. Positions are slide coordinates, so they apply on any slide. Each grab replaces the previous one.

button.label: Grab Left
button.screentip: Remember only this shape's horizontal position

button.label: Grab Top
button.screentip: Remember only this shape's vertical position

button.label: Grab Position
button.screentip: Remember this shape's left and top position

button.label: Grab Size + Position
button.screentip: Remember this shape's size and position - stamp its whole slot elsewhere

button.label: Apply
button.screentip: Give the selected shapes whatever was grabbed
button.supertip: Applies exactly what you grabbed - size, position, or both - to the selected shapes, on this slide or any other.

button.label: Apply Width
button.screentip: Give the grabbed width to the selected shapes

button.label: Apply Height
button.screentip: Give the grabbed height to the selected shapes

button.label: Swap Shapes
button.supertip: Centers swap, so different-sized shapes stay balanced in each other's spot.

button.label: Swap Corners
button.screentip: Two selected shapes trade top-left corners

button.label: TBU Marker
button.supertip: Pinned to the selected shape's top-right corner, or the slide's when nothing is selected.

button.label: Clear Slide
button.screentip: Remove every TBU marker on this slide

button.label: Clear Deck
button.screentip: Remove every TBU marker in the presentation

button.label: Copy to Rider
button.screentip: Copy this slide into the deck's rider file
button.supertip: Creates the rider on first use and appends on every use after that.

button.label: Move to Rider
button.screentip: Rip this slide out into the rider
button.supertip: The slide is deleted from this deck only after the rider has saved successfully.
